W.note: Competent generic bison steak with a one-line mammoth disclaimer and almost no mammoth world.

X.note: Rich, honest sourcing (Yuka, permits, dogs eating carcasses), carve-at-table showpiece and thorough method, though long and a bit heavy on caveats.

Y.note: Same strong research as X (lab-grown mammoth meatball, permafrost fry) plus a tundra-table serving scene, rye, lingonberry and a leftovers plan; tighter and more playful.

Z.note: Concise, clean recipe with a nice extinct-4000-years note and 'very ice age' juniper, but otherwise a standard game steak.
